parallels.note: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

translations.web: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
translations.bsb: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
translations.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
translations.asv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as angels in heaven.
